notes: The negated verbal generic takes the distributing rule at strength 0.0 with the adjectival restrictions as premise conjuncts and correctly no `QuantifierPhrase` companion (plain "not", not a quantifier word). "ground" is read as a participial modifier-adjective, which is licensed; under the competing noun-modifier reading it would instead have to fuse as `ground_feather` with genus `feather` only.
